name: Lava Interchangeable Hairstyling Wand
description: Enhance and combine currently trending hair appliance tools into one interchangeable option to create luxurious waves and curls, reducing frizz and eliminating static. Lava is known to be the best heat conductor in the world, allowing you to use lower heat settings while maintaining consistent heat that does not fluctuate like traditional irons or plates.  	Lava minerals provide gentle, consistent heat that maintains temperature to allow for one pass styling. Lava rocks are extremely durable and strong so plates will not scratch as easily and will last longer.  	Lava minerals produce more ions than traditional elements used in styling tools.  	Lower temperatures protect hair color.   UPC:633911815069

name: Babe Lash Eyelash Serum
description: What is it?    Longer-looking lashes start with the Babe Lash Essential Serum. This award-winning eyelash serum is our #1 best-seller and has a highly devoted following for one reason: it works! If you’ve wanted your lashes to look longer and more fluttery, all without needing extensions or falsies, consider this your sign to try the Babe Lash Essential Serum. Available in six-week, three-month, and six-month supplies.    Say goodbye to short and sparse lashes and hello to longer, fuller and healthier lashes with Babe Lash Eyelash Serum! This revolutionary eyelash serum is specially formulated to enhance the natural growth of your lashes, leaving you with beautiful, voluminous and long-lasting results.    What makes it special?    Infused with a powerful blend of peptides and natural extracts, this serum works to nourish and strengthen your lashes from the roots, promoting their growth and preventing any breakage or damage. The lightweight and easy-to-apply formula is perfect for everyday use, and can be easily incorporated into your existing beauty routine.    In just a few short weeks, you'll start seeing noticeable results, as your lashes become thicker, longer and more voluminous. And with continued use, you can enjoy long-lasting results that will make your lashes the envy of everyone around you.    Perfect for anyone looking to enhance their natural beauty, Babe Lash Eyelash Serum is a must-have product for anyone who wants to achieve full and fluttery lashes with minimal effort. So why wait? Give your lashes the love they deserve and get ready to turn heads with your stunning and irresistible look!    FAQ    How do I use Babe Lash Eyelash Serum?  To use Babe Lash Eyelash Serum, simply apply a small amount of the serum to the base of your upper lashes once a day, preferably before bedtime. The serum can also be used on your lower lashes if desired. For best results, it is recommended to use the serum consistently for 4-6 weeks.    Is Babe Lash Eyelash Serum safe to use?  Yes, Babe Lash Eyelash Serum is safe to use. The formula is ophthalmologist-tested and clinically proven to be gentle and non-irritating. However, it is important to avoid getting the serum in your eyes as it may cause irritation. Discontinue use if you experience any irritation.    Can I use Babe Lash Eyelash Serum if I have sensitive skin?  Yes, Babe Lash Eyelash Serum is safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin. The formula is gentle and non-irritating, and has been clinically tested to be safe and effective.    How long will it take to see results from Babe Lash Eyelash Serum?  Most users start seeing noticeable results after 4-6 weeks of consistent use. However, individual results may vary and some users may see results sooner or later than this timeframe.    Can I use Babe Lash Eyelash Serum with eyelash extensions?  Yes, Babe Lash Eyelash Serum can be used with eyelash extensions. However, it's recommended to avoid applying the serum directly to the extensions to prevent any damage or premature shedding. UPC:850032836449

name: Essential Mini Eyelash Serum
description: What is it?    Longer-looking lashes start with the Babe Lash Essential Serum. This award-winning eyelash serum is our #1 best-seller and has a highly devoted following for one reason: it works! If you’ve wanted your lashes to look longer and more fluttery, all without needing extensions or falsies, consider this your sign to try the Babe Lash Essential Serum. Available in six-week, three-month, and six-month supplies.    Say goodbye to short and sparse lashes and hello to longer, fuller and healthier lashes with Babe Lash Eyelash Serum! This revolutionary eyelash serum is specially formulated to enhance the natural growth of your lashes, leaving you with beautiful, voluminous and long-lasting results.    What makes it special?    Infused with a powerful blend of peptides and natural extracts, this serum works to nourish and strengthen your lashes from the roots, promoting their growth and preventing any breakage or damage. The lightweight and easy-to-apply formula is perfect for everyday use, and can be easily incorporated into your existing beauty routine.    In just a few short weeks, you'll start seeing noticeable results, as your lashes become thicker, longer and more voluminous. And with continued use, you can enjoy long-lasting results that will make your lashes the envy of everyone around you.    Perfect for anyone looking to enhance their natural beauty, Babe Lash Eyelash Serum is a must-have product for anyone who wants to achieve full and fluttery lashes with minimal effort. So why wait? Give your lashes the love they deserve and get ready to turn heads with your stunning and irresistible look!    FAQ    How do I use Babe Lash Eyelash Serum?  To use Babe Lash Eyelash Serum, simply apply a small amount of the serum to the base of your upper lashes once a day, preferably before bedtime. The serum can also be used on your lower lashes if desired. For best results, it is recommended to use the serum consistently for 4-6 weeks.    Is Babe Lash Eyelash Serum safe to use?  Yes, Babe Lash Eyelash Serum is safe to use. The formula is ophthalmologist-tested and clinically proven to be gentle and non-irritating. However, it is important to avoid getting the serum in your eyes as it may cause irritation. Discontinue use if you experience any irritation.    Can I use Babe Lash Eyelash Serum if I have sensitive skin?  Yes, Babe Lash Eyelash Serum is safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin. The formula is gentle and non-irritating, and has been clinically tested to be safe and effective.    How long will it take to see results from Babe Lash Eyelash Serum?  Most users start seeing noticeable results after 4-6 weeks of consistent use. However, individual results may vary and some users may see results sooner or later than this timeframe.    Can I use Babe Lash Eyelash Serum with eyelash extensions?  Yes, Babe Lash Eyelash Serum can be used with eyelash extensions. However, it's recommended to avoid applying the serum directly to the extensions to prevent any damage or premature shedding. UPC:850032836456

AdditionalDetails.DetailTitle:
Why We Love Babe Lash Essential Serum
  • Innovative formula for healthy, strong lashes.

  • The serum promotes the appearance of length, and the Enhancing Conditioner helps your lashes look thicker, fuller, and darker, all without needing lash extensions, falsies, or mascara.
  • The Essential Serum is full of powerful performance-based ingredients, like panthenol, and biotin, that nourish your natural lashes and help in reducing the appearance of damage from those environmental factors.

name: Tea Tree Special Hair & Scalp Treatment
description: Tea Tree Special Hair & Scalp Treatment - When hair and scalp issues need immediate intervention, get help with a tingly dose of strengthening conditioners found in this hydrating hair mask. It reconditions and repairs hair while moisturizing strands and soothing the scalp with soy protein, panthenol and shea butter. The stimulating fragrance of tea tree oil, peppermint and lavender protect, invigorate and leave hair smelling great.    Packaging may vary.    PCR Packaging:    In an effort to decrease John Paul Mitchell Systems' environmental impact, Tea Tree packaging is transitioning to post-consumer recycled materials—bottles and jars will be 100% PCR and tubes will be 25% PCR by 2025. By using PCR, the brand expects to reduce fossil fuel use by 41% and save an estimated 773 metric tons of virgin plastic. Join us in celebrating this uniqueness as we all do our part to help the planet. UPC:009531137254

AdditionalDetails.DetailTitle:
• Strengthens and Moisturizes: Soy proteins, panthenol, vitamin E and shea butter help recondition, repair and protect the hair.
  • Refines: Natural salicylic acid, derived from willow bark, refines and improves the texture of the skin.
  • Invigorates: The unique combination of tea tree oil, peppermint, and lavender creates a refreshing fragrance experience.
  • Cetyl Alcohol: Conditioning agent that helps prevent moisture loss.
  • Behentrimonium Methosulfate: An anti-static agent.
  • Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Oil: A completely natural, non-toxic disinfectant and germicide known for its healing properties; distilled from the leaves of the tea tree.
  • Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Oil: Essential oil distilled from the silvery lilac spikes of Lavandula Angustifolia, the well-known shrub which emits a cool, elegant, floral aroma with woody undertones.
  • Mentha Piperita (Peppermint) Oil: Peppermint oil has a long tradition of medicinal use; the strong, penetrating aroma has a sweet undertone; the oil is extracted from the fresh flowering tops of the plants; soothing and energizing.
  • Tocopheryl Acetate: An antioxidant and free radical scavenger that neutralizes molecules formed by UV radiation and environmental toxins and helps to repair the intercellular moisture barrier.
  • Panthenol: Provides long-lasting moisture, reduces the formation of split ends, thickens hair, provides shine and helps repair surface damage.
  • Salicylic Acid: Salicylic acid, a beta-hydroxy acid, is a highly effective superficial exfoliating agent, oil reducer and pore cleanser.
  • Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea Butter) Fruit: A fruit extract from the West African karite tree that contains oils and lipids to provide moisture and luster to the hair; its conditioning effect leaves hair soft and improves both wet and dry combing.

name: Tea Tree Special Detox Kombucha Rinse
description: Tea Tree Special Detox Kombucha Rinse - Give hair and scalp a total reset. This clarifying rinse exfoliates and removes buildup with a probiotic-rich blend of kombucha and apple cider vinegar. Leaves hair polished and scalp feeling soothed, clean and refreshed with an invigorating fresh scent.    Packaging may vary.    PCR Packaging:    In an effort to decrease John Paul Mitchell Systems' environmental impact, Tea Tree packaging is transitioning to post-consumer recycled materials—bottles and jars will be 100% PCR and tubes will be 25% PCR by 2025. By using PCR, the brand expects to reduce fossil fuel use by 41% and save an estimated 773 metric tons of virgin plastic. Join us in celebrating this uniqueness as we all do our part to help the planet. UPC:009531136950

AdditionalDetails.DetailTitle:
• Clarifying rinse infused with kombucha and apple cider vinegar to remove product build-up, excess oil and sebum from scalp.
  • Smooths and seals the hair cuticle for a super-polished, shiny look.
  • Boosts softness and shine.
  • Invigorating fragrance leaves hair smelling great.
  • Kombucha (Black Tea Ferment): Sourced from fermented black tea leaves, Kombucha is rich in antioxidants and lots of probiotics that help to balance the scalp and soothe irritation. The naturally occurring AHAs exfoliate the scalp by clearing out dirt, dead skin cells and excess sebum while promoting cell turnover to encourage a happy, healthy scalp.
  • Apple Cider Vinegar: Made from apple juice that is fermented and converted into vinegar, apple cider vinegar (ACV) has healing and anti-bacterial properties that balance the scalp pH and help reduce buildup. ACV cleanses hair without stripping and seals the cuticle, leaving hair soft and shiny.

name: NewCycle Round Thermal Brush 1 Inch
description: NewCycle Round Thermal Brush, the hairstylist's dream tool for creating the perfect blowout. With its ceramic-coated barrel, this brush heats up quickly and retains heat longer, ensuring even heat distribution and enhanced drying time. The large holes maximize airflow, making it ideal for creating volume, waves, or curls with ease.    But that's not all - the ion-charged bristles are heat-resistant and designed to hydrate the cuticle and add shine while eliminating frizz and flyaways. Plus, the anti-static design ensures a smooth and easy styling experience. The ergonomic comfort grip handle is designed for effortless rotation, making it easy to achieve your desired style without putting strain on your wrist. The lightweight and comfortable design, along with the snag-free neck ring and retractable sectioning pick, make styling a breeze.    But that's not all - the NewCycle Round Thermal Brush is also environmentally friendly! The barrel is made from recycled aluminum, with parts sourced from industrial aluminum manufacturing. The plastic parts are made from recycled appliances like refrigerators, washing machines, computers, and more. And the handle is made from post-consumer recycled items like shoes and toys. name: Titanium + Ion 1.5 Inch Curling Iron with Long Barrel
description: Elevate your hairstyling game with the Olivia Garden Titanium + Ion Curling Iron, designed specifically for professional hairstylists who demand the best in quality and performance. Crafted with an ultra titanium barrel, this curling iron promises unparalleled durability and longevity. It’s highly resistant to heat, scratches, corrosion, and wear, ensuring it remains a staple in your tool kit for years to come. The ultra-smooth, snag-free barrel guarantees effortless styling and is safe for all hair types.    High Performance for Flawless Results    Equipped with dual-ceramic heaters, the Olivia Garden curling iron heats up quickly to an impressive 455°F, delivering perfect, even-heat distribution and instant temperature recovery. This ensures consistent results, no matter how many clients you have in a day.    Ceramic Ionic Coated Clip    The ceramic ionic coated clip smooths curls while eliminating static and controlling frizz, leaving hair shiny and healthy-looking.    Precision Engineering    With a 1½ inch barrel diameter and an extra-long 6 1/4 inch usable barrel length, this curling iron offers versatility for creating a variety of styles. The lever features an ergonomic thumb design, providing superior grip and control, while the lightweight, ergonomic construction ensures comfort during extended use. The integrated clip hinge and silicone stand add to the snag-free design, making this curling iron both practical and efficient.      Customized Temperature Control    The easy-to-adjust temperature buttons are recessed to avoid accidental pressing, with five temperature settings ranging from 285°F to 455°F. For added safety, the curling iron features an auto shut-off after 30 minutes of inactivity.    Ergonomically Designed for Professionals    The custom design ergonomic handle boasts a unique neck design with extra grip for effortless rotation and a smooth handle body for an ultra-comfortable hold. The anti-slip texture ensures precise styling with every use.    360° Swivel Cord & Dual Voltage    An 8-foot, 360° swivel cord with a hanging loop allows for easy maneuverability, while dual voltage (100V-240V) makes it perfect for worldwide use.    Travel-Friendly    The included heat-resistant mat pouch with a pocket design is perfect for travel and storage, ensuring your curling iron remains in pristine condition wherever you go.    Choose the Olivia Garden Titanium + Ion 1½ Inch Curling Iron for professional-grade styling that meets the highest standards of quality, performance, and design. Your clients deserve the best, and so do you. UPC:752110210052
